note: The control register: Riverbend's PHI Access and Minimum Necessary Policy, as checks a machine runs. Drafted from the policy by skill:malloy-compliance-review, approved by the Privacy Officer, enforced on every change by compliance.py check.

partner.class: External data partner, data use agreement executed

controls.text: Every field on every published surface carries a classification.
Classification is declared where a field is defined and travels with it.
Every published surface that serves PHI is gated by workforce class; a request without a verified class is refused.
The base tables are not queryable by anyone.
A gate reads only attributes the identity provider sets.
A surface serves only the classes of data its workforce class needs, and declares them.
A join from a published surface does not extend the surface's access.
controls.why: Publisher refuses to load a package whose published source joins a gated source it does not scope, so a package that loads satisfies this.

controls.text: A clinician reads full PHI only for patients with an encounter at their organizations.
Billing reads identifiers, codes and financial data for the organizations it bills for.
A quality analyst reads a limited data set and no direct identifier.
A researcher reads de-identified data and nothing else.
An external partner reads a limited data set only under an executed data use agreement.
De-identified dates are years; ages over 89 are reported as 90.
De-identified geography is the state or a three-digit ZIP.
A de-identified surface carries no direct identifier.
A de-identified surface carries no free-text field.
A limited data set carries no direct identifier.
A limited data set is gated on a DUA for partners and on role for analysts.
Every query produces a record of who asked, which surface, which fields and classes, the decision, and the result's size, retained six years.
controls.why: Publisher writes the record for every query (docs/access-record.md). Where it is shipped and that it is kept six years are the log store's to prove, not the model's.

controls.text: An inventory of every published surface, gate, class and field, from the served model.
A change that would violate a control is refused, not deployed with a warning.
controls.why: The load refuses a #(carries) leak, a gate on a caller-set given and a join bypass; this review, run in CI, refuses the rest.
